from pandas.api.types import CategoricalDtype
from pandas.core.dtypes.dtypes import CategoricalDtype
from pandas.core.indexes.base import Index
from pandas.api.types import is_object_dtype
from pandas.api.extensions import CategoricalIndex
from pandas.api.extensions import ABCRangeIndex
from pandas.api.extensions import cast
from pandas.io.formats.format import format_object_summary
from pandas.core.common import is_string_dtype

@final
def _format_data(self, name=None) -> str:
    """
    Return the formatted data as a unicode string.
    """
    # do we want to justify (only do so for non-objects)
    is_justify = True

    if self.inferred_type == "string":
        is_justify = False
    elif isinstance(self.dtype, CategoricalDtype):
        self_new = cast("CategoricalIndex", self)
        if is_object_dtype(self_new.categories.dtype):
            is_justify = False
    elif isinstance(self, ABCRangeIndex):
        # We will do the relevant formatting via attrs
        return ""

    return format_object_summary(
        self,
        self._formatter_func,
        is_justify=is_justify,
        name=name,
        line_break_each_value=self._is_multi,
    )
